default.flavor: Canis Rex is the last unsullied remnant of House Cerberan. Under the expertise of its pilot, Sir Hekhtur, Canis Rex has become a vaunted legend. With pulsating volleys of laser ordnance and crushing sweeps of its huge gauntlet, enslaving oppressors are mercilessly crushed.
